resources.string: Handles Enter only when a supported message composer and its Send control are unambiguously identified. Message contents are never read or logged.
Only affects enabled ChatGPT, Messenger, and Claude Remote Control composers. Message text is never read, stored, or logged.

Enter / Numpad Enter: send
Shift+Enter: newline

Messenger and Claude Remote Control are off by default until you enable them above. Normal Claude chats and Dispatch remain native. After sending, Enter2Send waits for the Send control to clear before restoring composer focus. F8 dictation remains on the roadmap.
